## Summary
Build the Quick Spec Wizard UI where faculty define item generation specs through a conversational interface (max 10 turns), culminating in emitting `journey/generation.spec-confirmed`.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to define a generation specification through a guided wizard, so that the pipeline generates items aligned to my course objectives and USMLE targets.

## Why this matters
The spec is the input to the entire P3 pipeline. If the spec is poorly structured or missing required fields (SubConcept targets, SLO alignment, USMLE subtopic, Bloom level, item count), the pipeline produces unusable items and wastes Claude API budget.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Faculty can access the wizard from `/courses/[id]/generate`
- [ ] Wizard captures: target SubConcepts, SLOs, USMLE_Subtopic, Bloom level, difficulty band, item count, clinical context preferences
- [ ] Maximum 10 conversational turns before spec must be confirmed or abandoned
- [ ] Cost estimate displayed before confirmation (item_count * $0.12)
- [ ] If item_count > 10, explicit cost confirmation step required (C10)
- [ ] On confirm, emits `journey/generation.spec-confirmed` event via API route
- [ ] Spec saved to Supabase `generation_specs` table before event emission
- [ ] Wizard validates three-hub connectivity: selected SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic
- [ ] Loading states and error handling for API calls
- [ ] Responsive layout (desktop-first, functional on tablet)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase-first: save spec to Supabase BEFORE emitting Inngest event |
| Atomic Design | SpecWizard is an organism in features/item-generation/components/ |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- generation_specs table (if not already created by E04)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_specs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),
  faculty_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  spec_data JSONB NOT NULL,
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (item_count > 0 AND item_count <= 100),
  estimated_cost NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'confirmed', 'generating', 'completed', 'failed')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL
);

-- RLS policy
ALTER TABLE generation_specs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Faculty can manage own specs" ON generation_specs
  FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = faculty_id);

-- After adding: pnpm db:types
```

## API contract
```
POST /api/generation/spec
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  course_id: string,
  spec_data: {
    subconcept_ids: string[],
    slo_ids: string[],
    usmle_subtopic_ids: string[],
    bloom_level: string,
    difficulty_band: string,
    item_count: number,
    clinical_context?: { setting?: string, age_group?: string }
  }
}
Response: { data: { spec_id: string, estimated_cost: number }, error: null }
Error: { data: null, error: { code: string, message: string } }

POST /api/generation/spec/confirm
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { spec_id: string, cost_confirmed: boolean }
Response: { data: { spec_id: string, status: 'confirmed' }, error: null }
```

## Automated tests (Playwright -- runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E05/E05-S02.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Quick Spec Wizard loads on course generate page', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/courses/test-course-id/generate');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="spec-wizard"]')).toBeVisible();
});

test('Wizard enforces max 10 turns', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/courses/test-course-id/generate');
  // Simulate 10 turns
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    await page.locator('[data-testid="wizard-next"]').click();
  }
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="wizard-next"]')).toBeDisabled();
});

test('Cost confirmation required for >10 items', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/courses/test-course-id/generate');
  // Fill wizard with 15 items
  await page.fill('[data-testid="item-count"]', '15');
  await page.click('[data-testid="wizard-confirm"]');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="cost-confirm-dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="estimated-cost"]')).toContainText('$1.80');
});

test('Negative: spec without three-hub selection is rejected', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/courses/test-course-id/generate');
  // Skip SLO selection
  await page.click('[data-testid="wizard-confirm"]');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="validation-error"]')).toContainText('SLO');
});
```
